stories.title: 157th birth anniversary of Mahatma Gandhi
stories.body: the nation observes Gandhi Jayanti today, 2 October; it is also the birth anniversary of Lal Bahadur Shastri (of the 'Jai Jawan, Jai Kisan' call). The UN observes the day globally as the International Day of Non-Violence (UNGA Resolution 61/271, 2007). In the 138th episode of Mann Ki Baat, PM Modi called cleanliness the "most beautiful tribute" to Gandhi, recalling Bapu's mantra that cleanliness is one of his life's teachings.

stories.title: Swachhata Hi Seva 2026 concludes; Swachh Bharat Diwas
stories.body: the nationwide Swachhata Hi Seva 2026 campaign (17 September–2 October, theme "Swachhata Mein Sahbhag; Swachh Bharat, Viksit Bharat") culminates today, observed as Swachh Bharat Diwas; special Gram Sabhas and urban council meetings are being held to convert campaign actions into continuing local effort. Separately, the government's Special Campaign 6.0 for office cleanliness runs 2–31 October.

stories.title: National Wildlife Week begins
stories.body: observed every year from 2 to 8 October; programmes, nature walks, competitions and biodiversity-awareness activities will run across the country.

stories.title: ECI extends SIR dates for Andhra Pradesh and Meghalaya
stories.body: the Election Commission met for the second time in four days and extended the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls for Andhra Pradesh and Meghalaya.

stories.title: Oct 2 protest programmes announced
stories.body: several separate programmes were announced for Gandhi Jayanti: a CJP 'Jail Bharo Andolan' in Mumbai (after police denied permission for a Shivaji Park gathering), an AISA-linked protest at Jantar Mantar, New Delhi (11 am), and INDIA Bloc programmes — all centred on the Election Commission's functioning, electoral rolls and the SIR, with some groups demanding the CEC's removal.

stories.title: SC dismisses plea to operate frozen accounts
stories.body: the Supreme Court dismissed a plea by a TMC faction seeking permission to operate four debit-frozen bank accounts.

stories.title: Mann Ki Baat marks 10 years of the 2016 surgical strikes
stories.body: in the same 138th episode, PM Modi marked the tenth anniversary of the Indian Army's 2016 surgical strikes across the Line of Control, calling it a demonstration of India's resolve against terrorism.

stories.title: RBI bulk-deposit disclosure norm kicks in (1 Oct)
stories.body: the RBI's amended Directions on Interest Rates on Deposits are in force: banks must publish interest rates for bulk deposits of ₹3 crore and above on their websites every working day between 10:00 and 10:10 am, and must offer uniform rates for similar deposits booked the same day across all branches.

stories.title: RBI bars sale-back of seized assets to defaulters
stories.body: new directions effective 1 October tighten norms for stressed accounts: defaulting borrowers cannot repurchase seized properties; banks must dispose of such assets through public auctions within seven years and disclose them separately, outside NPA ratios.

stories.title: International card payments hit a reporting grey area
stories.body: new RBI trade-payment rules in force from 1 October mandate reporting of international credit-card transactions — the first time services trades are captured in RBI's digital reporting platforms (earlier only goods via customs and software data). No reporting mechanism has been specified yet for individuals' personal card payments abroad or corporate-card use, all categorised as 'import' under the rules.

stories.title: India's first Blue Financing deal: JNPA–IFC, USD 70 million
stories.body: the Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority and the International Finance Corporation signed a USD 70 million deal for Shore Power Supply infrastructure — India's first Blue Financing arrangement.

stories.title: Goyal–USTR talks on India–US trade deal
stories.body: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal reported a "productive discussion" with US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer on the early conclusion of the India–US trade deal.

stories.title: Captain Smit Machchhar hailed as hero
stories.body: on 30 September, a co-pilot allegedly stabbed Indian pilot Captain Smit Machchhar in a bid to crash flydubai flight FZ1073 (Dubai–Tel Aviv, Boeing 737 MAX 8, 174 passengers including 27 children); the injured captain activated the cockpit door release so crew and passengers could overpower the attacker, and the flight made an emergency landing at Tabuk, Saudi Arabia. On 1 October, President Droupadi Murmu and PM Modi hailed his "heroic courage", Israeli PM Benjamin Netanyahu credited him with averting a catastrophe, and Gujarat announced the 'Visisht Gujarat Garima Award' for him. He has been airlifted from Saudi Arabia to Dubai for treatment.

stories.title: Trump renames 'Artificial Intelligence' to 'Super Intelligence' in executive order
stories.body: US President Donald Trump formally replaced the term in a federal executive order.

stories.title: UK PM: 'strong indications' Iran involved in airbase incident
stories.body: the UK Prime Minister said there are strong indications of Iranian involvement in an airbase incident, amid wider West Asia tensions.

stories.title: Asian Games Day 14 (2 Oct): India at 66 medals, 8th
stories.body: India's tally stands at 10 gold, 23 silver, 33 bronze (66 total); China lead the table (154 gold). The 20th Asian Games at Aichi-Nagoya, Japan run 19 September–4 October; the Asian Para Games follow there 18–24 October — India's 5th appearance.

stories.title: Men's hockey: India beat Pakistan 4-3 to reach the final
stories.body: a thriller booked India's place in the Asian Games men's hockey final.

stories.title: Men's cricket into the final
stories.body: Ishan Kishan's unbeaten 80 on a tough pitch carried India through the semifinal into the Asian Games men's T20 cricket final.

stories.title: Wrestler Nitesh wins Greco-Roman silver
stories.body: India's wait for an Asian Games Greco-Roman champion continues; Nitesh took silver.

stories.title: RRB ALP CBT 2 Result 2026 declared
stories.body: zone-wise merit list and scorecard for the Railway Assistant Loco Pilot recruitment released.

stories.title: Women's hockey: historic gold after 44 years
stories.body: India beat defending champions China 1-0 in the final (Lalremsiami's 10th-minute field goal; goalkeeper Savita Punia's late saves held the lead) — the team's first Asian Games gold since 1982, and the win sealed direct qualification for the LA 2028 Olympics. It was India's sixth gold of the day and 16th of the Games.

stories.title: Lovlina Borgohain: boxing gold on her 29th birthday
stories.body: beat China's Bao Ziyi 5-0 in the women's 75kg final; the first Indian woman boxer to win Asian Games gold since Mary Kom (Incheon 2014) — she had won silver in Hangzhou and bronze at Tokyo 2020.

stories.title: Parveen Hooda: women's 65kg gold
stories.body: edged Paris Olympic bronze-medallist Chen Nien-chin (Chinese Taipei) 3-2 in the final; with Lovlina, the first Indian women boxers to win two golds at a single Asian Games edition.

stories.title: Ankush Panghal: men's 80kg boxing gold
stories.body: beat South Korea's Kim Minseong 4-0 in the final.

stories.title: Maiden women's recurve archery team gold
stories.body: Ankita Bhakat, Kirti Sharma and 17-year-old Kumkum Mohod stunned 10-time Olympic champions South Korea 5-3 in the final — India's first-ever Asian Games gold in women's recurve team (India had beaten China 5-1 in the semifinal).

stories.title: Sujeet Kalkal: wrestling 65kg gold
stories.body: beat Tajikistan's Abdulmazhid Kudiev 10-9 in the men's freestyle 65kg final.

stories.title: Recurve silvers + sailing bronze
stories.body: the men's recurve team (Dhiraj Bommadevara, Neeraj Chauhan, Yashdeep Bhoge) lost 1-5 to Korea for silver; the mixed recurve pair Kumkum Mohod–Dhiraj Bommadevara lost 3-5 to China for silver; Nethra Kumanan took bronze in the women's dinghy sailing.

stories.title: Six golds on Day 14
stories.body: Lovlina, Parveen, Ankush, women's recurve archery team, Sujeet Kalkal and women's hockey took India's tally past 75 medals with 16 golds, keeping India near the top five of the medal table.

stories.title: HDFC Bank: Anup Bagchi to be MD & CEO
stories.body: the board appointed him for a 3-year term from 27 October 2026 after the RBI approved the appointment on 1 October (u/s 35B, Banking Regulation Act, 1949); he joins as additional director from 2 October and succeeds Sashidhar Jagdishan. Bagchi is an ICICI Group veteran since 1992 (ex-executive director of ICICI Bank; currently MD & CEO of ICICI Prudential Life Insurance); IIT Kanpur + IIM Bangalore alumnus.

stories.title: September GST at ₹2.03 lakh crore
stories.body: gross collections of ₹2,03,521 crore, up 14.7% YoY (Finance Ministry data, released 1 October); domestic GST +10.1%, import GST +25.9%; net GST after refunds ₹1.76 lakh crore, up 18.1% YoY — the third straight month above ₹2 lakh crore.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu's 'Vettri Payanam' rolls out
stories.body: CM C. Joseph Vijay launched the expanded free-bus-travel scheme for women and transgender persons at Koyambedu, Chennai, on Gandhi Jayanti; it covers 12,692 government buses (~69% of the fleet) across Ordinary, Express, LSS, Deluxe and mofussil services, is expected to benefit ~84.32 lakh women daily at a cost of ~₹6,000 crore a year, with no income ceiling or trip cap (Chengalpattu and Tiruppur districts excluded due to bypolls).

stories.title: Mahanadi dispute back on the table
stories.body: the Union Home Minister chaired a meeting with the CMs of Chhattisgarh and Odisha in New Delhi on the inter-state water dispute; the Mahanadi Water Disputes Tribunal was set up in March 2018 under the Inter-State River Water Disputes Act, 1956 (Article 262).

stories.title: First tigress released in Buxa
stories.body: a 3-year-old, 150-kg Royal Bengal tigress was released in West Bengal's Buxa Tiger Reserve on 2 October, launching the tiger rehabilitation programme; the release was flagged off by the Union Environment Minister and the West Bengal CM.

stories.title: Ladakh saffron pilot + makhana to Greece
stories.body: saffron cultivation began in Leh as a pilot with ~90,000 premium Iranian corms (~800 kg); APEDA facilitated a 1-MT consignment of popped makhana from Purnea (Bihar) to Greece.

stories.title: Defence & trade notes
stories.body: BrahMos exports are projected to cross $600 million (Philippines, Vietnam, Indonesia; the Philippines has already received its consignment); the Department of Commerce extended timelines under Component II of the RELIEF scheme (Resilience & Logistics Intervention for Export Facilitation) on 2 October.

stories.title: FASTag + barrier-free tolling
stories.body: revised exempted-FASTag rules for Divyangjan/PwD vehicles take effect from 2 October: validity tied to disability percentage (5 years for 70–100%, 3 years for 40–<70%), linked to UDID records; NHAI rolled out Multi-Lane Free Flow (ANPR + FASTag) tolling at Paranur plaza in Tamil Nadu (Tambaram–Tindivanam, NH-179B) — the state's first MLFF location.

one_liners: 2 October observances: 157th Gandhi Jayanti + Lal Bahadur Shastri Jayanti; International Day of Non-Violence (UNGA Res 61/271, 2007); Swachh Bharat Diwas; Wildlife Week (2–8 Oct) begins; Special Campaign 6.0 (2–31 Oct).
Swachhata Hi Seva 2026: 17 Sept–2 Oct; theme "Swachhata Mein Sahbhag; Swachh Bharat, Viksit Bharat".
Mann Ki Baat (138th ep.): cleanliness as the "most beautiful tribute" to Gandhi; 10th anniversary of 2016 surgical strikes.
ECI: SIR dates extended for Andhra Pradesh and Meghalaya (2nd EC meeting in 4 days).
RBI bulk FD rules (from 1 Oct): bulk deposits = ₹3 crore+; rates published 10:00–10:10 am daily on bank websites; uniform same-day rates across branches.
RBI stressed-asset rule: no sale-back of seized assets to defaulters; public auction within 7 years; disclosed outside NPA ratios.
Blue Financing: JNPA + IFC, USD 70 million, Shore Power Supply infra — India's first.
flydubai FZ1073 (30 Sept): Dubai–Tel Aviv; Captain Smit Machchhar thwarted a crash attempt, emergency landing at Tabuk; praised by Murmu, Modi, Netanyahu; Gujarat's 'Visisht Gujarat Garima Award'.
Trade: Goyal–USTR Greer talks on early conclusion of India–US trade deal.
US: 'Artificial Intelligence' renamed 'Super Intelligence' in a Trump executive order.
Asian Games 2026 (Aichi-Nagoya): India 66 medals (10G/23S/33B), 8th; hockey final after 4-3 win over Pakistan; cricket into final (Kishan's unbeaten 80); wrestler Nitesh Greco-Roman silver.
Asian Para Games: Aichi-Nagoya, 18–24 October; India's 5th appearance.
RRB ALP CBT 2 Result 2026 declared (zone-wise merit list + scorecard).
